def max_rects(grid, min_h=3, min_w=3):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); rects=[]
 for top in range(h):
  cols=[True]*w
  for bot in range(top,h):
   cols=[cols[c] and grid[bot][c]!=0 for c in range(w)]
   if bot-top+1<min_h: continue
   c=0
   while c<w:
    if not cols[c]: c+=1; continue
    l=c
    while c<w and cols[c]: c+=1
    rr=c-1
    if rr-l+1<min_w: continue
    # maximal if no extension up/down/left/right preserving full rectangle
    extup=top>0 and all(grid[top-1][x]!=0 for x in range(l,rr+1))
    extdown=bot<h-1 and all(grid[bot+1][x]!=0 for x in range(l,rr+1))
    extleft=l>0 and all(grid[y][l-1]!=0 for y in range(top,bot+1))
    extright=rr<w-1 and all(grid[y][rr+1]!=0 for y in range(top,bot+1))
    if not (extup or extdown or extleft or extright): rects.append((top,l,bot,rr))
 return rects

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    comp = [[-1]*w for _ in range(h)]
    marker_color = {}
    cid = 0
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or comp[r][c] >= 0:
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; comp[r][c]=cid; color=None
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                if grid[y][x] > 1: color=grid[y][x]
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=0 and comp[yy][xx]<0:
                        comp[yy][xx]=cid; stack.append((yy,xx))
            marker_color[cid]=color; cid+=1
    # Find maximal solid rectangles of foreground (1 or a color marker), at least 3x3.
    for top in range(h):
        columns=[True]*w
        for bottom in range(top,h):
            columns=[columns[c] and grid[bottom][c]!=0 for c in range(w)]
            if bottom-top+1 < 3: continue
            c=0
            while c<w:
                if not columns[c]: c+=1; continue
                left=c
                while c<w and columns[c]: c+=1
                right=c-1
                if right-left+1 < 3: continue
                can_extend = (
                    (top>0 and all(grid[top-1][x]!=0 for x in range(left,right+1))) or
                    (bottom+1<h and all(grid[bottom+1][x]!=0 for x in range(left,right+1))) or
                    (left>0 and all(grid[y][left-1]!=0 for y in range(top,bottom+1))) or
                    (right+1<w and all(grid[y][right+1]!=0 for y in range(top,bottom+1)))
                )
                if can_extend: continue
                color=marker_color[comp[top][left]]
                if color is None: continue
                for r in range(top+(bottom-top)//2, top+(bottom-top)//2 + (1 if (bottom-top+1)%2 else 2)):
                    for x in range(left+(right-left)//2, left+(right-left)//2 + (1 if (right-left+1)%2 else 2)):
                        if grid[r][x]==1: out[r][x]=color
    return out
